name: Round 2 fixed train and validation population

preregistration.training: Round-one train scene AND seed 1 or 2 (68 measured runs including realism).
preregistration.validation: Any round-one held-out scene OR seed 101 (82 measured runs including realism).
preregistration.model: Standardised L2 logistic regression, deterministic gradient descent; train-only site cross-fitting for conformal residual calibration. No validation threshold search.
preregistration.acceptance: Rule 4, every train/validation x off/on partition: coverage loss <=0.02; silent-wrong/scene no increase; 1/2 sigma distance from nominal no worse; paired median/p90/risk-area CI strictly better or every inference and score equal.
preregistration.ranking: No ranking from partial or unequal populations; useful scene rate is primary coverage-adjusted endpoint.
